newsitem.title: UK: Asda shares active in block trading.
newsitem.headline: Asda shares active in block trading.

text.p: Shares in supermarket operator Asda Group Plc were heavily traded on Friday though market-makers said it was no more than two-way business between unnamed institutional investors. The stock was down 3/4p at 114-1/2 in volume of 25 million shares by 1139 GMT -- making it the most active stock in London.
"It is just a bit of two-way trade," said one dealer.
Traders said they were unaware of the identity of the institutions involved. Asda is often one of the most active stocks in London with daily volume frequently passing 20 million shares.
